title: The best music app ever
content: The only app I found where you can easily manage your music files using folders, like on your computer. But for me personally there is one feature missing. I would like to have ‘Documents’  folder as the start page when you launch the app. This customization (when you’re able to choose the start page) is just crucial feature. It would be great if you add it. Besides this, the app is just flawless. Keep it up!
